authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3696 kṣīra explicitly gives Oriya khira and northern chīr milk. These forms fit the milk family; survey ṣīr requires distinguishing Iranian šīr or a demonstrated local change. Exact survey form cīr is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10049 mānuṣa explicitly gives Gawri mānuṣ, while 9828 manuṣya lists short-vowel manuṣ forms and collisions. Gawri mānūṣ selects 10049; other insufficiently diagnostic forms remain under comparative review. Exact survey form mānūṣ is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
